trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Bangalore, MC.No.691/2005
case_name: Smt Latha Sharma vs Sri Ramesh Vyas @ Manoj
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia) of Hindu Marriage Act seeking divorce. Respondent died in May 1999. Petitioner alleged mental and physical torture by respondent's family after his death.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's desertion of the other for a continuous period of 2 years preceding the presentation of the petition warrants granting the relief of divorce.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner has proved that after the solemnization of his marriage with her, he has deserted her continuously for a period of 2 years, which warrants for granting the relief of divorce?

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's failure to discharge marital obligations towards the other, despite being able to do so, can be considered as desertion.
legal_principles.held: However, he failed to visit the petitioner even though the birth of child was the respondent, which will amount to desertion.

outcome.final_order: Decree dated 24-3-2007 made by the Family Court, Bangalore, was set aside.
